product.name: Degen Walkie
product.description: A pocket perp-trading terminal you talk to.
product.size: about 9 x 6 cm and 1 cm thin, fits in one hand like a deck of cards
product.usage: held in one hand; hold the mic on the glass and talk into it like a walkie-talkie; thumb presses the trade key on the right edge

product.summary: A pocket perp-trading terminal you talk to: hold the mic, say the trade, check the ticket, press the physical trade key.
product.sides: front: glass screen; back: camera lens at the top, six gold contacts, speaker grille, optional magnetic 4G clip; right edge (seen from the front): mint trade key and knurled thumb wheel

features: Delegated trading: the private key never leaves your wallet
Voice rooms with traders worldwide, live-translated
One pocket terminal: perps on three venues, spot, memes, news
tagline: Your trading terminal, in your pocket.

story.title: Anywhere
story.logline: Street, metro, café: he trades, stays safe and talks to traders worldwide, all by voice.
